On the functional space, the anisopterans Diplacodes lefebvrii, Trithemis kirbyi, Sympetrum fonscolombii, Orthetrum nitidinerve, Trithemis annulata, Crocothemis erythraea and Paragomphus genei were located at one side of the first fPCA axis and all of them will potentially expand their potential distribution (Supporting information S8).

Aeshna mixta, Sympetrum striolatum, Lestes sponsa and Lestes dryas were categorised as either ‘Reduced and displaced’ or ‘Reduced’ in the Iberian Peninsula, but are found to moderately increase their range in Sweden (Termaat et al., 2019).
